_meta.format: ZIP containing cat_turnover_DDMMYY.xls (BIFF8); sheet0 daily rows, sheet1 monthly history
_meta.parser_note: Scratch stdlib BIFF8 extractor v4: LABELSST/NUMBER/RK/MULRK/FORMULA-numeric decoded; RK high-30-bit fix + MULRK ixfe-offset fix applied before acquisition.
_meta.failure_cause: NSE reports-archive IP-window throttling (HTTP 404 bursts during sequential acquisition; single-session recovery succeeded on retry while bulk re-runs re-throttled).
_meta.recommended_recovery: Re-run scratch/g11c_inst_resume.py after an off-hours cool-down (e.g., next morning IST); script is resume-safe and skip-valid.

recovery_20260911_classification.note: 404 = file absent from NSE live archive (control date 200 same session); not throttling, not zero-deals

_meta.verification_method: Inner-XLS CRC32 + semantic row comparison (NOT container SHA256): NSE regenerates the ZIP container per request (fresh embedded timestamp, same byte size, same inner CRC, identical data), so container-level SHA256 is unstable by design for this endpoint family. Disk files match their acquisition-time manifest SHA256 exactly; inner CRC32 recorded per entry for stable re-verification.
